verdict.rationale: Capacities publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at api.capacities.io/openapi.json, links it directly from its developer docs, and renders it as an interactive reference. The probe 404s were on the docs.capacities.io host, not the api host, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of fetching the spec at api.capacities.io, and confirmation that the successor developers.capacities.io portal offers a downloadable spec (the documented one belongs to the Beta API being discontinued September 1, 2026).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: If you need programmatic access to the API specification, you can download the OpenAPI 3.0 Specification
